title: Glessner's courtyard windows, sash by sash
items: The Glessner courtyard's windows are now real double-hung sash on rock-faced stone sills, where each was one dark pane behind a flat frame. The hall bow and the dining bay have the same sash on their curved and angled faces.
The four windows over the courtyard underpass are two-over-two, and the courtyard's basement windows stand behind iron bars, as the c. 1923 photograph of the court shows.
